verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an independent third-party security audit of the Proton Pass apps or their sync protocol, published or otherwise. The pack documents end-to-end encryption and open-source client repositories, but these are adjacent security-posture claims, not audits. For a password manager this axis clearly applies, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the vendor publishes independent security audits of the app and its sync protocol
